nodes.languageNotes: Single-document YAML with 7 top-level sections (always, state, skill_summary, run_level, netlist, psf, exclude). Used as data input by the maestro snapshot skill.

nodes.name: main.rs
nodes.summary: Entrypoint for the feature-gated virtuoso-daemon binary: spawns a TCP listener, dispatches SkillRequest messages, and writes per-skill stats/callback files.
nodes.languageNotes: Standalone main.rs with SkillRequest struct (camelCase serde fields) plus stdlib networking (TcpListener). No internal crate imports detected by import extractor.

nodes.name: config.rs
nodes.summary: Integration tests for the vcli config layer: env vs file precedence, defaults, digest stability, allow_cross_user_daemon overrides, and TUI save round-trip via EnvGuard + isolate_config_dir helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines EnvGuard RAII helper; uses vcli public test API plus std::env::set_var/remove_var. 17 test functions.

nodes.name: config_check.rs
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the config_check JSON-shape report: every known key carries a source, env wins over file wins over default, malformed values degrade to warnings, and empty profile sections fall through to global.
nodes.languageNotes: Two test fixtures (EnvGuard, ConfigDirRestore). 11 test functions, no external deps beyond the library crate.

nodes.name: config_check_cli.rs
nodes.summary: CLI-level tests for the `vcli config-check` subcommand: broken active target emits structured JSON and a non-zero exit; valid target exits zero with valid=true.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps the compiled vcli binary through EnvGuard; uses assert_cmd/process-style assertions. 5 test functions.

nodes.name: daemon_user_guard.rs
nodes.summary: Broad integration suite for daemon user/session hygiene: client_id sanitization & overrides, session_info serde round-trip with/without daemon_user and daemon_version, ramic_bridge version + IPC pinger+1 wiring, and VB_CACHE_DIR / VB_LOG_DIR env override propagation.
nodes.languageNotes: 33 test functions covering both serialization and behavioral contracts. No mock framework; uses std::sync::Mutex ENV_LOCK for serial env mutation.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker for tests/docs so unittest discovery picks up the docs test module.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-line (empty) __init__.py file.

nodes.name: test_x11_dismiss_dialog.py
nodes.summary: unittest suite for resources/x11_dismiss_dialog.py: covers window-line parsing, _NET_WM_PID handling, geometry parsing, dialog sizing, action choice, and Virtuoso class detection.
nodes.languageNotes: Loads the helper via importlib.util.spec_from_file_location (no package install). 6 TestCase classes, 1 helper function _load_helper.

nodes.name: error_handling.rs
nodes.summary: Tests for the unified error/Result types in vcli: Display/Debug formatting, transport failure vs success, ok_or_exec semantics, and per-kind error variants (timeout/conflict/auth) with retryable metadata.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure unit tests; no IO. 18 test functions covering Display/Debug/From impls and constructors.

nodes.name: linux_rename_compat.rs
nodes.summary: Verifies that the linux-only rename-compat shim module is absent on non-Linux targets (compile-time cfg gating).
nodes.languageNotes: Single test that fails to compile if the compat module leaks into non-Linux builds. 138 lines incl. comments.

nodes.name: maestro_csv.rs
nodes.summary: CSV parser tests for MaestroResult: single-point AC, multi-point sweep, specs/weights, quoted parameters, scientific notation, header-only files, multi-test layouts, summary parsing, and trailing newline artifacts.
nodes.languageNotes: Calls MaestroResult::parse_csv on inline fixture strings. 11 test functions.

nodes.name: ocean.rs
nodes.summary: Tests for OCEAN (OceanScript) skill emission: setup_skill generates progn, escapes embedded quotes; analysis_skill handles simple numbers/booleans/strings; sweep_skill emits desvar; parse_skill_list tolerates nested/single/nil/quoted shapes; corner_config structure stable.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure unit tests against library helpers. 11 test functions.

nodes.name: skill_escape.rs
nodes.summary: Targeted unit tests for the Skill string-escape utility: basic strings, embedded double quotes, backslashes, complex mixed content, empty input, whitespace preservation, unicode, and that parentheses are NOT escaped.
nodes.languageNotes: 8 short test functions; very small surface area (74 lines total).

nodes.name: skill_finder_include_desc.rs
nodes.summary: Behavioral tests for skill search with include_description toggled: fuzzy matches hit descriptions, name-shape filters still apply, case-insensitive matching, prefix/suffix filters, regex mode, result limit, and edge cases (empty query, unloaded finder).
nodes.languageNotes: Builds an inline SkillFinder::Corpus + Finder for each scenario. 13 test functions.

nodes.name: skill_load.rs
nodes.summary: Integration tests for the load skill path: admin gating before bridge RPC, local file preservation of absolute path and .ils suffix, symlink suffix + path escaping, RPC success returns execution-host path, nil/skill-error propagation, and raw nil remains a valid expression result.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines a Bridge helper (TcpListener on 127.0.0.1:0 + worker thread) to simulate the daemon. 13 test functions.

nodes.name: spectre.rs
nodes.summary: Tests for Spectre (analog) skill generation: setup_skill progn + escape; analysis_skill number/boolean/string handling; sweep_skill with multiple measures; parse_skill_list tolerates nested/single/nil/quoted/flat/mixed shapes; corner_skill structural shape.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure unit tests. 14 test functions.

nodes.name: tunnel_hostname_check.rs
nodes.summary: CLI tests for `vcli tunnel status` hostname-check behavior: unreachable daemon path, JSON top-level keys, missing hostname check, tunnel section reports not-running, config section reflects env overrides, table format includes daemon section, and skip when no remote host.
nodes.languageNotes: Spawns vcli with Command::new + env overrides. 8 test functions.

nodes.name: tunnel_profile.rs
nodes.summary: CLI + helper tests for profile-scoped config dirs: helpers produce distinct dirs per profile, env keys carry profile suffixes, bind_user/clear lifecycle, user-scope does not touch real $HOME, and bind_user rejects no-scope and multi-scope forms.
nodes.languageNotes: Spawns the compiled vcli binary with custom PATH/profiles. 9 test functions.
